label: 3. Is the Commander in the group yet?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Is the Commander in the group yet?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Commander, say something.
What is this?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: The Commander has joined our group chat!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Finally.
What is this about?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: This is the blabla group chat for the Counters.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: As long as it's not an emergency, you can use this to issue any orders you have.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: And we can just chit-chat as well, heehee!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Anyway, it's nice to be working with you,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: though I don't know how long it'll end up being.
I'm sure we'll get along just fine.
I suppose that depends on your attitude.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I think so too!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: So if I don't follow orders, you'll kick me to the curb, is that it?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Anis!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'm just joking!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: By the way, what's up with our squad being called Counters?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I mean, it's certainly better than Squad 04-F, but what gives?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I'm sure there's a perfectly valid reason for it.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: And in the future, try being a little more tactful when asking questions.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: All right, all right.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Anyway, let's all do our best

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: to work together!
